notes: All 5 photos are menus. Photos 2, 4 and 5 are the same laminated table menu (A1-A16 soup-base items plus C1-C5 specialty bowls); photo 5 is the clearest/most complete (includes C5) and those items were merged from all three rather than duplicated. Photo 1 is a separate wall-mounted board listing Hot-Stone-Pot 'Crossing Bridge' rice noodles plus Rice Noodle Bowl / Hand-Pulled Noodle Bowl combos and a short appetizer list; photo 3 is the back panel of the table menu with a different appetizer list (D1-D9) and a drinks list. Because the board and the table menu are two distinct physical documents, some very similar dishes appear on both with different prices (e.g. Mala Spicy Beef Tripe $9.99 on the board vs Spicy Beef Tripe $7.99 on the table menu, Crispy Fried Chicken $8.99 vs $7.99) - both are transcribed as printed rather than merged. Add-on/topping items (B1-B10) and soft-drink listings (F1-F10) were skipped per instructions.
